skills.description: Establishes the permitted engagement, target and action budgets before any web or API test. Use at the start of every autonomous assessment.
Maps a JavaScript-heavy application with headless Playwright and authenticated BrowserContexts. Use for SPAs, UI workflows and DOM-driven endpoints.
Builds a durable, queryable inventory of routes, requests and states from browser, proxy and crawler observations.
Finds candidate API routes and client-side sinks in bundled JavaScript and correlates them with live browser traffic.
Discovers additional query parameter names on selected observed anonymous GET endpoints with bounded Arjun.
Correlates headers, static assets, observed behavior and source manifests to identify technologies with evidence.
Selects reviewed Nuclei GET/HEAD or approved POST replay templates; treats CVE and VulnX metadata as context rather than proof.
Plans controlled authentication/session lifecycle checks and routes exact replay/refresh without claiming full login or MFA automation.
Checks JWT validation and lifetime expectations without accepting decoded token content as a security proof.
Tests object-level authorization across isolated accounts, object owners and tenants.
Tests endpoint/function-level and field/property-level privilege boundaries for assigned application roles.
Checks a captured GET or selected private POST input projection with pinned Schemathesis and bounded integer generation.
Checks an explicit SQLi hint on a captured GET query parameter with bounded boolean-only sqlmap.
Reviews NoSQL and LDAP query boundaries with technology-aware, controlled validation and source-dataflow correlation.
Checks a selected reflected GET input with Dalfox, then confirms target-delivered JavaScript in isolated Chromium.
Assesses suspected server-side command execution paths using authorized non-destructive evidence and explicit impact gates.
Validates a captured GET or one approved private POST field with pinned TInjA and a finite host-enforced template profile.
Evaluates whether server-side URL fetching violates intended destination restrictions, using controlled OAST targets.
Reviews XML parsing and external entity handling, corroborating any observed callbacks with parser and request context.
Checks file path normalization and inclusion boundaries using controlled fixture files and evidence-aware comparison.
Maps upload, transformation and download workflows for authorization, validation and unsafe processing issues.
Checks browser-origin protections for actual state-changing operations with isolated test accounts.
Assesses cross-origin browser access against explicit origin and credential policies using headless Chromium.
Evaluates HTTP framing risks through controlled gateway/backend comparisons in an isolated environment.
Checks whether untrusted data improperly changes HTTP header boundaries or logging metadata.
Reviews serializer formats and unsafe decoding paths, combining SAST evidence with bounded runtime validation.
Checks state invariants under controlled concurrency and compares them with sequential baseline behavior.
Examines JavaScript object merge and parsing paths for unsafe prototype handling with local isolated fixtures.
Assesses dangling DNS and provider ownership with evidence of real claimability rather than DNS heuristics.
Models multi-step business workflows and checks documented invariants that generic scanners cannot infer.
Correlates HTTP callbacks from a reviewed GET or authenticated private POST with durable Interactsh polling.
Combines source taint analysis and package vulnerability data to prioritize reachable security defects.
Validates, deduplicates and retests candidate findings using independent controls and persisted evidence.
Builds concise reports with source-linked findings, residual gaps, fixes and machine-readable artifacts.
Schedules bounded independent test jobs from inventory state while limiting LLM context and repeated work.
Plans port and service discovery for an explicitly authorized network scope.
Tracks DNS/asset relationships while keeping observed and authorized states separate.
Performs targeted assessment of an evidenced WordPress surface while respecting licensing requirements.
Audits configuration for a designated cloud account, project and region.
Assesses Kubernetes configuration against a version-specific benchmark.
Triages crashes and backtraces from local binary fixtures within resource limits.
Analyzes exceptional recovery cases while program code handles routine recovery.
Analyzes shared resource deviations across workers, browsers, caches and LLM context.
Checks context-sensitive cache freshness, invalidation and single-flight behavior.
Reviews evidence relationships and unproven attack-chain hypotheses.
Evaluates comparable local benchmarks and any loss of coverage.
Reviews a controlled lab reproducer and its fixed control.
